This section includes three settings: 1) The toggle switch controls whether the temperature sensor is ignored. If disabled, the outdoor temperature sensor will be ignored when automations are triggered. It is important to ensure that ventilation and heating are not enabled on the same seat simultaneously. 2) The left slider adjusts the restriction on repeated automation activation. If set to 0, automation will activate whenever the specified conditions are met. If set to, for example, 10 hours, the automation will not activate again within that time frame. The countdown starts from the last automation trigger. 3) The right slider sets the time after which automation will no longer activate. For example, if set to 0, automation will trigger as soon as conditions are met. If set to 10 minutes, automation will not activate after 10 minutes of driving, even if conditions are met. The countdown starts from when the head unit is turned on.
